newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Jan 30.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Commentary marks second anniversary of President Jiang Zemin's eight-point proposition on Taiwan, calls for more exchanges between Straits to promote reunification
- President and Communist Party secretary Jiang Zemin calls on party members of to combat corruption.
- Official communique calls for battle against corruption
- Survey finds new investors in 1996 accounted for 43.2 percent of total investors in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges
- China's retail sales of consumer goods seen reaching 228.7 billion yuan in January, up 19.8 percent
- China's Foreign Exchange Trading Centre's total turnover reached $62.84 billion in 1996.
- China's automobile demand seen at 1.55-1.65 billion units in 1997 while production is seen at 1-6 million in 1997.
- Commentary suggests how to handle Hong Kong Bill of Rights Ordinance better for safeguarding Sino-British Joint Declaration.
